audit: READ-ONLY content & copy-quality + cross-page consistency audit of milosvasic.ru and vasic.digital

read: milosvasic.ru/_site/**/*.html (generated) — EN pages + en/ articles only
vasic.digital/**/*.html — EN pages + en/ articles only
committed PDFs via pdftotext (served EN + legacy orphaned)
excluded_by_instruction: machine-translated _content_<lang> and articles/<lang> (non-EN) for copy quality
no Go generator run; no source edits (read-only)

findings.location_served: milosvasic.ru/downloads/Milos_Vasic_Cover_Letter_EN.pdf (served as the English 'Cover Letter' download via milosvasic.ru/_site/assets/js/downloads.js: FILES.cl='Milos_Vasic_Cover_Letter', AVAIL.cl=['EN','SR','RU','DE'])
findings.quote: Dear [Hiring Manager / Team],  ...  I am writing to apply for the [role] position at [company]. ... I would welcome the chance to bring that combination ... to [company].
findings.evidence: pdftotext of Milos_Vasic_Cover_Letter_EN.pdf contains literal '[Hiring Manager / Team]', '[role]', and '[company]' (twice).
findings.note: The bracket placeholders are intentional-per-application in the markdown (frontmatter note), but they leak into a live, downloadable published PDF.
findings.suggested_fix: Ship a placeholder-free general edition for the public download (e.g. 'Dear Hiring Team,' and rephrase the [role]/[company] sentences to be company-agnostic), and keep the bracketed template as a non-published source only.

findings.quote_title: <title>Milos Vasic | Senior Software Engineer — SDK & Platform Engineering</title>
findings.quote_description: <meta name="description" content="Milos Vasic — Senior Software Engineer specializing in SDK and platform engineering across mobile, backend, desktop, and web. 15+ years building high-performance, developer-facing software. Author of Fundamental Kotlin.">
findings.contradicts: Visible page body is the AI-engineer narrative: eyebrow '// AI engineer', H1 'Miloš Vasić', lede 'AI engineer building verifiable AI-development systems: multi-provider LLM infrastructure, autonomous agents ...'.
problems: Title/description present the LEGACY 'Senior Software Engineer — SDK & Platform Engineering' positioning, contradicting the AI-engineer page content (this is what shows in search results / social shares).
Name rendered without diacritics ('Milos Vasic') while the H1 and body use 'Miloš Vasić'.
findings.suggested_fix: Regenerate the home <title>, og:title, description, og:description from the AI-engineer source (_content/sites/milosvasic-ru.md), e.g. title 'Miloš Vasić — AI Engineer'.

findings.location: milosvasic.ru/_site/index.html + all 36 product pages (footer); product/portfolio <title> tags
findings.quote_footer: © 2026 Milos Vasic — Belgrade · Dubna. Built as a static site, deployed on GitHub Pages.
findings.quote_titles: e.g. '<title>HelixCode — Miloš Vasić | Milos Vasic</title>', '<title>Portfolio — Miloš Vasić | Milos Vasic</title>'
findings.evidence: Footer uses ASCII 'Milos Vasic' (36 files under milosvasic.ru/_site) while hero H1 is 'Miloš Vasić'; product/portfolio titles carry BOTH forms in one string.
findings.not_a_cross_site_leak: The personal 'Milos Vasic — Belgrade · Dubna' footer appears ONLY on milosvasic.ru (0 occurrences on vasic.digital, which correctly uses '© 2026 Vasic Digital').
findings.suggested_fix: Pick one canonical spelling ('Miloš Vasić') for footer and titles, or intentionally standardize on ASCII everywhere; do not mix both in a single <title>.

findings.quote: <meta name="description" content="Helix Cluster OS is a next-generation ..."> and JSON-LD "description":"Helix Cluster OS is a next-generation ..."
findings.evidence: Meta description and JSON-LD write 'Helix Cluster' (spaced) while the brand is CamelCase 'HelixCluster' (8 visible occurrences on the same page). Visible body copy is correct; only the SEO metadata is inconsistent.
findings.suggested_fix: Use 'HelixCluster' in the meta description and JSON-LD.

findings.quote: 'One interface, 43 providers' (prose) vs '43+ providers' / '43+ provider adapters' (stat chips) vs 'multi-provider LLM abstraction (40+ providers)' / '40+ provider access'.
findings.evidence: Three forms of the LLM-provider count coexist: exact '43', chip '43+', and rounded '40+'.
findings.assessment: Not a hard contradiction — '40+' is a deliberate rounded/general figure and '43' the exact LLMProvider count — but '43' vs '43+' for the same capability is ambiguous.
findings.suggested_fix: Harmonize the LLMProvider count: use '43' (or '43+') consistently; keep '40+' only where the general 'multi-provider abstraction' is meant.

findings.location: milosvasic.ru/_site/index.html meta ('15+ years') vs served CV_EN.pdf ('Over 15 years ... since 2009') vs legacy orphaned PDFs ('16+ years')
findings.evidence: Live-served docs say '15+' / 'Over 15 years'; only the orphaned legacy PDFs say '16+ years'. (2026 − 2009 = 17, so all are conservative/true.)
findings.suggested_fix: Standardize on one figure ('15+ years' or 'since 2009') across meta, CV, and any retained legacy artifacts.

findings.not_linked: downloads.js always appends a _LANG suffix (Milos_Vasic_CV_EN.pdf etc.), so these no-suffix base PDFs are NOT reachable from the UI.
contradictions_vs_current: '240+ open-source repositories across five organizations'  vs current '140+ repositories' everywhere (LEGACY_CV.pdf, LEGACY_Cover_Letter.pdf).
email i@mvasic.ru + phone numbers vs current milos85vasic@gmail.com on the served CV/CL.
'Milos Vasic' (no diacritics) and 'Senior Software Engineer — SDK & Platform Engineering' positioning — the same stale identity that leaked into the home <head> (M1).
findings.suggested_fix: Delete or regenerate the orphaned base PDFs (and _site/pages/*.pdf) so no committed artifact claims 240+ repos / 16+ years / SDK positioning; they are the residue the current narrative replaced.

clean_confirmations.product_name_casing_visible_copy: Consistent CamelCase across both sites + PDFs (HelixCode, HelixTrack, HelixAgent, HelixLLM, HelixQA, HelixMemory, HelixCluster, ...). Only exception: helixcluster.html SEO metadata (L2).
clean_confirmations.markdown_render_integrity: No literal ** / ## / ]( / unclosed code fences in any EN HTML; no mojibake; no broken/empty in-prose links or images.
clean_confirmations.titles_h1: Every full page has exactly one non-empty, unique <title> and one <h1>; no duplicate titles. Article files are fragments (single <h1>, no <title>) injected via articles.js — by design.
clean_confirmations.en_source_prose: _content/docs/*.md, _content/sites/*.md, _content/products/*.md — no spelling/grammar/doubled-word/broken-sentence/duplicated-paragraph defects. 'TBD/UNVERIFIED/PLANNED/SCAFFOLD/placeholder-documented' in product md are deliberate anti-bluff honesty markers, not accidental leftovers.
